# Land & More Reality Ltd.

> Land & More Reality Ltd. (RC: 9035696) sells verified, titled land plots at Dara Villa
> Luxury Estate in Uyo, Akwa Ibom State, Nigeria. Every plot comes with a Registered
> Survey, a Certificate of Deposit, and an Irrevocable Power of Attorney.

## Location
Dara Villa Luxury Estate, New Ring Road by Berger Junction, Off Idoro Road, Uyo,
Akwa Ibom State, Nigeria.

## What we offer
- Plots from 300 square metres, with flexible payment plans over 3 to 12 months
- Free site inspections booked online or via WhatsApp
- Registered, dispute-free titles with full legal documentation
- After-sales support through and beyond development
